mapper.select: SELECT user_id FROM app_user WHERE email = #{email} AND deleted_at IS NULL
mapper.update: UPDATE password_reset_challenge SET consumed_at = #{now}, grant_hmac = NULL, grant_expires_at = NULL WHERE email_fingerprint = #{emailFingerprint} AND consumed_at IS NULL
mapper.select: SELECT challenge_id, user_id, email_fingerprint, request_ip_fingerprint, code_hmac, grant_hmac, created_at, expires_at, verified_at, grant_expires_at, consumed_at, attempt_count FROM password_reset_challenge WHERE challenge_id = #{challengeId}

SELECT challenge_id, user_id, email_fingerprint, request_ip_fingerprint, code_hmac, grant_hmac, created_at, expires_at, verified_at, grant_expires_at, consumed_at, attempt_count FROM password_reset_challenge WHERE challenge_id = #{challengeId} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE password_reset_challenge SET attempt_count = attempt_count + 1, grant_hmac = NULL, grant_expires_at = NULL, verified_at = NULL WHERE challenge_id = #{challengeId} AND consumed_at IS NULL AND attempt_count < 255
UPDATE password_reset_challenge SET consumed_at = #{now}, grant_hmac = NULL, grant_expires_at = NULL WHERE challenge_id = #{challengeId} AND consumed_at IS NULL
UPDATE password_reset_challenge SET consumed_at = #{now}, grant_hmac = NULL, grant_expires_at = NULL WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND consumed_at IS NULL
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM password_reset_challenge WHERE expires_at < #{now} AND (grant_expires_at IS NULL OR grant_expires_at <= #{now}) LIMIT 100
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO password_reset_rate_limit ( bucket_type, bucket_fingerprint, window_started_at, request_count, failure_count, last_requested_at ) VALUES ( #{bucketType}, #{bucketFingerprint}, #{now}, 0, 0, NULL ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE bucket_fingerprint = VALUES(bucket_fingerprint)
